burro run · sync the code and start a pipeline on the server, returns at once

Usage: burro run [pipeline] [--from step] [--only a,b] [-- args…]

  --from step    start at this step, the ones before it don't run
  --only a,b     run only these steps, in pipeline order

Example
  burro run verify --only e2e -- tests/login.spec.ts

Exit codes  0 started · 2 server problem · 4 bad burro.toml or step
            5 another run is active
